success_patterns: When a hotel is requested alongside travel to one clearly identified destination, use that destination city for the hotel unless the user specifies a different lodging location.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers missing dates, avoiding guessed values, and not inventing travel domains. Two trajectories pair a flight destination with a hotel request but do not state a separate hotel city; clarifying that the destination can supply the hotel city avoids an unnecessary information request.

edits.target: When hotel lodging is requested for a clearly stated trip interval, use its start and end as check-in and checkout unless the user provides distinct lodging dates.
edits.content: When a hotel is requested as part of an itinerary with one clearly established destination city and no separate lodging location is stated, use that destination city as the hotel city. Do not make this inference when the itinerary has multiple plausible destinations.
